description_excerpt: The Position The Brand Manager plays a pivotal role in driving the success of assigned brands within the Operating Unit (OPU). This role is responsible for executing brand strategies, enhancing customer engagement, and ensuring cross-functional alignment to achieve business objectives. The Brand Manager collaborates closely with regional (ROPU) and local teams to deliver impactful marketing initiatives, support product launches, and drive sustainable growth.
